name: Nude Cafe Berawa
description: is a popular Australian-style cafe in Tibubeneng, Bali, known for its healthy food, vibrant atmosphere, and focus on fresh, high-quality ingredients. It serves breakfast, lunch, dinner, and drinks, with many options for vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free diets. The cafe offers both indoor and outdoor seating and is a popular spot for locals and digital nomads
